summary: This RFC listed the documents that specified the official protocols of the ARPA Internet, with notes on planned revisions. It was a periodic status report, now only of historical interest. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 901.

eli5.summary: A librarian made a list of the official rulebooks everyone on the network was supposed to follow. Later the list got old and was replaced by a new one.

questions: what were the official arpa internet protocols
